realm.name: cockpit-admin
realm.description: Full administrative access: salary read/write, Owner-equivalent access on every org tree, and implies cockpit-analytics. Does not bypass board access checks — boards still require their own BoardAccess role.

realm.name: cockpit-analytics
realm.description: Read access to engineering-intelligence dashboards. A timesheet read that names an org tree also requires Viewer on that tree; one with no tree needs only this role. Granted automatically to anyone holding cockpit-admin.
